versions.changelog:
Initial release of oxypages-publish.

- Publish static websites (HTML, CSS, JS, images, or ZIPs) to OxyPages and receive a live HTTPS link.
- Supports quick, unclaimed 30-minute links without an account, or permanent hosting with an OxyPages API key.
- Relays important details: live URL, expiry, claim link, and which files (if any) were skipped.
- Handles API responses and relays errors and limitations clearly to the user.
- Clearly defines consent and safe publishing rules before making content public.
